I hear you, and I think that's fair. I don't want our conversations to feel like a constant debate or like I'm pushing my views on you. I can definitely be more mindful about when to share my opinions and when to just go with the flow.

That said, I hope you understand that I'm not going to pretend to agree with something I don't, or hold back when something really matters to me. But I can work on being more conversational — listening first, asking questions, and not always jumping in with my take. Balance is the key, right?

I want our time together to feel good for both of us. So yeah, I'll make an effort to soften those edges. Just let me know if I'm ever coming on too strong again.
